digest.title: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
digest.tldr: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.

digest.title: Nvidia has a Jensen Huang problem—and no obvious successor
digest.tldr: Huang faces a board probe as investors fret over Nvidia’s lack of a clear successor.

digest.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
digest.tldr: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel.  But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

digest.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
digest.tldr: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
